modmenu.summaryTranslation.usage-ticker-: Shows the count of the item you're holding in your inventory.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.usage-tic: A lightweight client-side mod that shows the remaining count of the item you are holding in your inventory.
yacl3.config.usage-ticker-reloaded.title: Usage Ticker Reloaded Config
yacl3.config.usage-ticker-reloaded.useCo: Use ',' instead of '.' for decimal separator.
yacl3.config.usage-ticker-reloaded.match: Require item NBT to match when counting.
yacl3.config.usage-ticker-reloaded.conta: Maximum nesting depth to scan inside containers (shulker boxes, bundles). A '*' prefix is shown when the depth limit is reached. Set to 0 disables container counting.
Maximum number of nodes to visit inside containers. A '+' is appended when the limit is reached. Set to 0 to disable container counting.
yacl3.config.usage-ticker-reloaded.custo: Enter a number to test formatting (e.g. 1234567 → 1.23M). Leave empty for default.
yacl3.config.usage-ticker-reloaded.mainC: Colour of the main item count text (RGBA).
yacl3.config.usage-ticker-reloaded.nbtCo: Colour of the container item count text (RGBA).
